metadata.name: Laboratory measurements of Magallana hongkongensis (mollusk) in Zhanjiang
metadata.description: A dataset of laboratory measurements for the oyster species Magallana hongkongensis, including various treatment groups and physicochemical parameters (e.g., stiffness, hardness, density, pH, temperature, salinity, carbonate chemistry) collected at a single site in Zhanjiang (latitude 21.33333, longitude 110.66667) on 2016-06-01.
